description: OpenVids grants the webview window dragging only. The window loads http://127.0.0.1 pages (the Projects home and Studio) — remote origins as far as Tauri is concerned — and the overlay titlebar has no native title bar to grab, so those pages mark their titlebars with data-tauri-drag-region and need start_dragging (plus internal_toggle_maximize for the macOS double-click zoom). Nothing else: every file read, write, upload and delete already goes through the home and Studio HTTP APIs, which run in Rust or the sidecar with full OS access.
